imu

class IMU(i2c, addr=40)

BNO055 IMU Driver

Takes in a pyb.I2C object preconfigured in CONTROLLER mode.

i2c

I2C bus object used to communicate with the BNO055.

addr

7-bit I2C address of the IMU.

set_mode(mode)

Change IMU operating mode (fusion modes included).

get_cal_status()

Retrieve and parse calibration status. Returns (sys, gyr, acc, mag) each from 0–3.

read_euler()

Returns (heading, roll, pitch) in degrees.

heading()

Returns heading (yaw) in degrees.

read_gyro()

Returns (gx, gy, gz) in degrees/second.
